} from "lucide-react";
import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import Link from "next/link";
import { useParams } from "next/navigation";

interface FriaRisk {
  id: number;
  type: string;
  severity: "low" | "medium" | "high" | "critical";
  probability: number;
  impact: "low" | "medium" | "high";
  description: string;
}

interface MitigationMeasure {
  id: number;
  description: string;
  effectiveness: number;
  associatedRiskId: number | null;
}

interface FriaDetail {
  id: number;
  projectId: number;
  projectName: string;
  createdAt: string;
  updatedAt: string;
  status: "DRAFT" | "COMPLETED" | "NOTIFIED";
  completenessScore: number;
  finalRisk: number | null;
  riskLevel: "low" | "medium" | "high" | "critical" | null;
  authorityNotified: boolean;
  authorityNotifiedAt: string | null;
  dpiaId: string | null;
  steps: {
    step1: {
      processDescription: string;
    };
    step2: {
      usagePeriodStart: string;
      usagePeriodEnd: string;
      usageFrequency: string;
    };
    step3: {
      affectedCategories: string[];
      vulnerableGroups: string;
      vulnerableGroupsIncluded: boolean;
    };
    step4: {
      risks: FriaRisk[];
    };
    step5: {
      humanOversight: string;
      hitlEnabled: boolean;
    };
    step6: {
      mitigationMeasures: MitigationMeasure[];
    };
  };
}

const mockFriaDetail: FriaDetail = {
  id: 1,
  projectId: 1001,
  projectName: "AI Credit Scoring System",
  createdAt: "2025-12-01T10:00:00Z",
  updatedAt: "2025-12-01T15:30:00Z",
  status: "COMPLETED",
  completenessScore: 0.95,
  finalRisk: 0.42,
  riskLevel: "medium",
  authorityNotified: false,
  authorityNotifiedAt: null,
  dpiaId: null,
  steps: {
    step1: {
      processDescription:
        "The AI system is used for automated credit scoring in loan applications. It analyzes applicant data including financial history, employment status, and demographic information to determine creditworthiness.",
    },
    step2: {
      usagePeriodStart: "2024-01-01",
      usagePeriodEnd: "2025-12-31",
      usageFrequency: "daily",
    },
    step3: {
      affectedCategories: [
        "Loan applicants",
        "Credit card applicants",
        "Low-income individuals",
      ],
      vulnerableGroups: "Recent immigrants, individuals with limited credit history",
      vulnerableGroupsIncluded: true,
    },
    step4: {
      risks: [
        {
          id: 1,
          type: "Discrimination",
          severity: "high",
          probability: 0.75,
          impact: "high",
          description:
            "Risk of discrimination based on protected characteristics such as race, gender, or age",
        },
        {
          id: 2,
          type: "Privacy",
          severity: "medium",
          probability: 0.50,
          impact: "medium",
          description:
            "Risk of unauthorized access to sensitive financial data",
        },
      ],
    },
    step5: {
      humanOversight:
        "Human reviewers will review all loan rejections and decisions with scores below 0.6. Pre-deployment review required for model updates. In-loop supervision for high-value loans (>€50,000).",
      hitlEnabled: true,
    },
    step6: {
      mitigationMeasures: [
        {
          id: 1,
          description: "Regular bias audits every quarter",
          effectiveness: 0.80,
          associatedRiskId: 1,
        },
        {
          id: 2,
          description: "Encryption and access controls for data",
          effectiveness: 0.90,
          associatedRiskId: 2,
        },
      ],
    },
  },
};

export default function FriaDetailPage() {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const params = useParams();
  const friaId = params.id as string;
  const [fria, setFria] = useState<FriaDetail | null>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);

  useEffect(() => {
    loadFriaDetail();
  }, [friaId]);

  const loadFriaDetail = async () => {
    try {
      setLoading(true);
      // TODO: Reemplazar con llamada real a API
      await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 500));
      setFria(mockFriaDetail);
    } catch (error) {
      console.error("Error loading FRIA detail:", error);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const notifyAuthority = async () => {
    if (!fria) return;
    try {
      const response = await fetch(
        `/api/compliance/fria/${fria.id}/notify-authority`,
        {
          method: "POST",
        }
      );
      const result = await response.json();
      if (result.success) {
        loadFriaDetail();
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error("Error notifying authority:", error);
    }
  };

  if (loading || !fria) {
    return (
      <div className="flex items-center justify-center min-h-screen">
        <div className="animate-spin rounded-full h-12 w-12 border-b-2 border-primary"></div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-gradient-to-br from-background via-background to-background/80 relative overflow-hidden">

      <div className="relative z-10 w-full px-4 py-6 space-y-6">
        {/* Header */}
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
            <Link href="/governance/compliance/fria/assessments">
              <Button variant="ghost" size="sm">
                <ArrowLeft className="h-4 w-4 mr-2" />
                {t("compliance.fria.back")}
              </Button>
            </Link>
            <div>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-3 mb-2">
                <FileText className="w-8 h-8 text-blue-500" />
                <h1 className="text-3xl font-bold bg-gradient-to-r from-blue-500 to-blue-700 bg-clip-text text-transparent">
                  {t("compliance.fria.detail", { id: fria.id })}
                </h1>
              </div>
              <p className="text-muted-foreground">{fria.projectName}</p>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div className="flex gap-2">
            {fria.status === "DRAFT" && (
              <Link href={`/governance/compliance/fria?friaId=${fria.id}`}>
                <Button variant="outline">
                  <Edit className="h-4 w-4 mr-2" />
                  {t("compliance.fria.edit")}
                </Button>
              </Link>
            )}
            {fria.status === "COMPLETED" &&
              fria.finalRisk !== null &&
              fria.finalRisk >= 0.75 &&
              !fria.authorityNotified && (
                <Button variant="outline" onClick={notifyAuthority}>
                  <Send className="h-4 w-4 mr-2" />
                  {t("compliance.fria.notifyAuthority")}
                </Button>
              )}
            <Button variant="outline">
              <Download className="h-4 w-4 mr-2" />
              Exportar PDF
            </Button>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Summary Cards */}
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4 gap-4">
          <Card>
            <CardBody>
              <div className="text-sm text-muted-foreground mb-1">Estado</div>
              <Badge
                variant={
                  fria.status === "NOTIFIED"
                    ? "destructive"
                    : fria.status === "COMPLETED"
                    ? "default"
                    : "secondary"
                }
              >
                {t(`compliance.fria.status.${fria.status.toLowerCase()}`)}
              </Badge>
            </CardBody>
          </Card>
          <Card>
            <CardBody>
              <div className="text-sm text-muted-foreground mb-1">
                Completitud
              </div>
              <div className="text-2xl font-bold">
                {(fria.completenessScore * 100).toFixed(0)}%
              </div>
            </CardBody>
          </Card>
          <Card>
            <CardBody>
              <div className="text-sm text-muted-foreground mb-1">
                Riesgo Final
              </div>
              {fria.finalRisk !== null ? (
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                  <div className="text-2xl font-bold">
                    {(fria.finalRisk * 100).toFixed(0)}%
                  </div>
                  <Badge
                    variant={
                      fria.riskLevel === "high" || fria.riskLevel === "critical"
                        ? "destructive"
                        : "default"
                    }
                  >
                    {fria.riskLevel &&
                      t(`compliance.fria.riskLevels.${fria.riskLevel}`)}
                  </Badge>
                </div>
              ) : (
                <span className="text-muted-foreground">-</span>
              )}
            </CardBody>
          </Card>
          <Card>
            <CardBody>
              <div className="text-sm text-muted-foreground mb-1">
                Fecha Creación
              </div>
              <div className="text-sm">
                {new Date(fria.createdAt).toLocaleDateString()}
              </div>
            </CardBody>
          </Card>
        </div>

        {/* Step 1: Process Description */}
        <Card>
          <CardHeader>
            <CardTitle>
              Paso 1: {t("compliance.fria.steps.step1.title")} (Art. 27.1.a)
            </CardTitle>
          </CardHeader>
          <CardBody>
            <p className="whitespace-pre-wrap">{fria.steps.step1.processDescription}</p>
          </CardBody>
        </Card>

        {/* Step 2: Usage Period & Frequency */}
        <Card>
          <CardHeader>
            <CardTitle>
              Paso 2: {t("compliance.fria.steps.step2.title")} (Art. 27.1.b)
            </CardTitle>
          </CardHeader>
          <CardBody>
            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4">
              <div>
                <div className="text-sm text-muted-foreground mb-1">
                  Período de Uso
                </div>
                <div>
                  {fria.steps.step2.usagePeriodStart} -{" "}
                  {fria.steps.step2.usagePeriodEnd}
                </div>
              </div>
              <div>
                <div className="text-sm text-muted-foreground mb-1">
                  Frecuencia
                </div>
                <div>
                  {t(
                    `compliance.fria.steps.step2.frequencyOptions.${fria.steps.step2.usageFrequency}`
                  )}
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          </CardBody>
        </Card>

        {/* Step 3: Affected Categories */}
        <Card>
          <CardHeader>
            <CardTitle>
              Paso 3: {t("compliance.fria.steps.step3.title")} (Art. 27.1.c)
            </CardTitle>
          </CardHeader>
          <CardBody>
            <div className="space-y-4">
              <div>
                <div className="text-sm text-muted-foreground mb-2">
                  Categorías Afectadas
                </div>
                <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
                  {fria.steps.step3.affectedCategories.map((category, index) => (
                    <Badge key={index} variant="secondary">
                      {category}
                    </Badge>
                  ))}
                </div>
              </div>
              <div>
                <div className="text-sm text-muted-foreground mb-2">
                  Incluye Grupos Vulnerables
                </div>
                <Badge variant={fria.steps.step3.vulnerableGroupsIncluded ? "default" : "secondary"}>
                  {fria.steps.step3.vulnerableGroupsIncluded ? "Sí" : "No"}
                </Badge>
              </div>
              {fria.steps.step3.vulnerableGroupsIncluded && fria.steps.step3.vulnerableGroups && (
                <div>
                  <div className="text-sm text-muted-foreground mb-2">
                    Grupos Vulnerables
                  </div>
                  <p>{fria.steps.step3.vulnerableGroups}</p>
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          </CardBody>
        </Card>

        {/* Step 4: Risks */}
        <Card>
          <CardHeader>
            <CardTitle>
              Paso 4: {t("compliance.fria.steps.step4.title")} (Art. 27.1.d)
            </CardTitle>
          </CardHeader>
          <CardBody>
            <div className="space-y-4">
              {fria.steps.step4.risks.map((risk) => (
                <Card key={risk.id} className="p-4">
                  <div className="flex justify-between items-start mb-2">
                    <div>
                      <div className="font-semibold mb-1">{risk.type}</div>
                      <div className="flex gap-2">
                        <Badge variant="secondary">
                          Severidad:{" "}
                          {t(
                            `compliance.fria.steps.step4.severityOptions.${risk.severity}`
                          )}
                        </Badge>
                        <Badge variant="secondary">
                          Probabilidad: {(risk.probability * 100).toFixed(0)}%
                        </Badge>
                        <Badge variant="secondary">
                          Impacto:{" "}
                          {t(
                            `compliance.fria.steps.step4.impactOptions.${risk.impact}`
                          )}
                        </Badge>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  <p className="text-sm mt-2">{risk.description}</p>
                </Card>
              ))}
            </div>
          </CardBody>
        </Card>

        {/* Step 5: Human Oversight */}
        <Card>
          <CardHeader>
            <CardTitle>
              Paso 5: {t("compliance.fria.steps.step5.title")} (Art. 27.1.e)
            </CardTitle>
          </CardHeader>
          <CardBody>
            <div className="space-y-4">
              <div>
                <div className="text-sm text-muted-foreground mb-2">
                  HITL Habilitado
                </div>
                <Badge variant={fria.steps.step5.hitlEnabled ? "default" : "secondary"}>
                  {fria.steps.step5.hitlEnabled ? "Sí" : "No"}
                </Badge>
              </div>
              <div>
                <div className="text-sm text-muted-foreground mb-2">
                  Descripción
                </div>
                <p className="whitespace-pre-wrap">{fria.steps.step5.humanOversight}</p>
              </div>
            </div>
          </CardBody>
        </Card>

        {/* Step 6: Mitigation Measures */}
        <Card>
          <CardHeader>
            <CardTitle>
              Paso 6: {t("compliance.fria.steps.step6.title")} (Art. 27.1.f)
            </CardTitle>
          </CardHeader>
          <CardBody>
            <div className="space-y-4">
              {fria.steps.step6.mitigationMeasures.map((measure) => {
                const associatedRisk = fria.steps.step4.risks.find(
                  (r) => r.id === measure.associatedRiskId
                );
                return (
                  <Card key={measure.id} className="p-4">
                    <div className="flex justify-between items-start mb-2">
                      <div className="flex-1">
                        <p className="mb-2">{measure.description}</p>
                        <div className="flex gap-2">
                          <Badge variant="secondary">
                            Efectividad: {(measure.effectiveness * 100).toFixed(0)}%
                          </Badge>
                          {associatedRisk && (
                            <Badge variant="outline">
                              Riesgo: {associatedRisk.type}
                            </Badge>
                          )}
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </Card>
                );
              })}
            </div>
          </CardBody>
        </Card>

        {/* Additional Information */}
        <Card>
          <CardHeader>
            <CardTitle>Información Adicional</CardTitle>
          </CardHeader>
          <CardBody>
            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4">
              <div>
                <div className="text-sm text-muted-foreground mb-1">
                  Notificación a Autoridades
                </div>
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                  {fria.authorityNotified ? (
                    <>
                      <CheckCircle className="h-4 w-4 text-green-500" />
                      <span>
                        Notificado el{" "}
                        {fria.authorityNotifiedAt &&
                          new Date(
                            fria.authorityNotifiedAt
                          ).toLocaleDateString()}
                      </span>
                    </>
                  ) : (
                    <>
                      <AlertTriangle className="h-4 w-4 text-yellow-500" />
                      <span>No notificado</span>
                    </>
                  )}
                </div>
              </div>
              <div>
                <div className="text-sm text-muted-foreground mb-1">
                  DPIA Vinculado
                </div>
                {fria.dpiaId ? (
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                    <LinkIcon className="h-4 w-4" />
                    <span>{fria.dpiaId}</span>
                  </div>
                ) : (
                  <span className="text-muted-foreground">No vinculado</span>
                )}
              </div>
            </div>
          </CardBody>
        </Card>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

      humanOversight: string;
      hitlEnabled: boolean;
    };
    step6: {
      mitigationMeasures: MitigationMeasure[];
    };
  };
}

export default function FriaDetailPage() {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const params = useParams();
  const friaId = params.id as string;
  const [fria, setFria] = useState<FriaDetail | null>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);

  useEffect(() => {
    loadFriaDetail();
  }, [friaId]);

  const loadFriaDetail = async () => {
    try {
      setLoading(true);
      // TODO: Reemplazar con llamada real a API
      await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 500));
      setFria(mockFriaDetail);
    } catch (error) {
      console.error("Error loading FRIA detail:", error);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const notifyAuthority = async () => {
    if (!fria) return;
    try {
      const response = await fetch(
        `/api/compliance/fria/${fria.id}/notify-authority`,
        {

        }

      if (result.success) {

    }
  };

  if (loading || !fria) {

      <div className="relative z-10 w-full px-4 py-6 space-y-6">

              fria.finalRisk >= 0.75 &&

                  <Send className="h-4 w-4 mr-2" />
                  {t("compliance.fria.notifyAuthority")}
                </Button>
              )}

              <Download className="h-4 w-4 mr-2" />
              {t("compliance.fria.exportPDF")}
            </Button>

              <div className="text-sm text-muted-foreground mb-1">Estado</div>

                variant={
                  fria.status === "NOTIFIED"
                    ? "destructive"
                    : fria.status === "COMPLETED"
                    ? "default"
                    : "secondary"
                }
              >
                {t(`compliance.fria.status.${fria.status.toLowerCase()}`)}
              </Badge>
            </CardBody>
          </Card>
          <Card>
            <CardBody>
              <div className="text-sm text-muted-foreground mb-1">
                Completitud
              </div>
              <div className="text-2xl font-bold">
                {(fria.completenessScore * 100).toFixed(0)}%
              </div>
            </CardBody>
          </Card>
          <Card>
            <CardBody>
              <div className="text-sm text-muted-foreground mb-1">
                Riesgo Final
              </div>
              {fria.finalRisk !== null ? (
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                  <div className="text-2xl font-bold">
                    {(fria.finalRisk * 100).toFixed(0)}%
                  </div>
                  <Badge
                    variant={
                      fria.riskLevel === "high" || fria.riskLevel === "critical"
                        ? "destructive"
                        : "default"
                    }
                  >
                    {fria.riskLevel &&
                      t(`compliance.fria.riskLevels.${fria.riskLevel}`)}
                  </Badge>
                </div>
              ) : (
                <span className="text-muted-foreground">-</span>
              )}
            </CardBody>
          </Card>
          <Card>
            <CardBody>
              <div className="text-sm text-muted-foreground mb-1">
                Fecha Creación
              </div>
              <div className="text-sm">
                {new Date(fria.createdAt).toLocaleDateString()}
              </div>
            </CardBody>
          </Card>

        {/* Step 1: Process Description */}
        <Card>
          <CardHeader>
            <CardTitle>

          </CardHeader>
          <CardBody>

          </CardBody>
        </Card>

        {/* Step 2: Usage Period & Frequency */}
        <Card>
          <CardHeader>
            <CardTitle>

            </CardTitle>
          </CardHeader>
          <CardBody>
            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4">
              <div>
                <div className="text-sm text-muted-foreground mb-1">
                  Período de Uso
                </div>
                <div>
                  {fria.steps.step2.usagePeriodStart} -{" "}
                  {fria.steps.step2.usagePeriodEnd}
                </div>
              </div>
              <div>
                <div className="text-sm text-muted-foreground mb-1">
                  Frecuencia
                </div>
                <div>
                  {t(
                    `compliance.fria.steps.step2.frequencyOptions.${fria.steps.step2.usageFrequency}`
                  )}
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          </CardBody>
        </Card>

        {/* Step 3: Affected Categories */}
        <Card>
          <CardHeader>
            <CardTitle>
              Paso 3: {t("compliance.fria.steps.step3.title")} (Art. 27.1.c)
            </CardTitle>
          </CardHeader>
          <CardBody>
            <div className="space-y-4">
              <div>
                <div className="text-sm text-muted-foreground mb-2">
                  Categorías Afectadas
                </div>
                <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
                  {fria.steps.step3.affectedCategories.map((category, index) => (
                    <Badge key={index} variant="secondary">
                      {category}
                    </Badge>
                  ))}
                </div>
              </div>
              <div>
                <div className="text-sm text-muted-foreground mb-2">
                  Incluye Grupos Vulnerables
                </div>
                <Badge variant={fria.steps.step3.vulnerableGroupsIncluded ? "default" : "secondary"}>
                  {fria.steps.step3.vulnerableGroupsIncluded ? "Sí" : "No"}
                </Badge>
              </div>
              {fria.steps.step3.vulnerableGroupsIncluded && fria.steps.step3.vulnerableGroups && (
                <div>
                  <div className="text-sm text-muted-foreground mb-2">
                    Grupos Vulnerables
                  </div>
                  <p>{fria.steps.step3.vulnerableGroups}</p>
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          </CardBody>
        </Card>

        {/* Step 4: Risks */}
        <Card>
          <CardHeader>
            <CardTitle>
              Paso 4: {t("compliance.fria.steps.step4.title")} (Art. 27.1.d)
            </CardTitle>
          </CardHeader>
          <CardBody>
            <div className="space-y-4">
              {fria.steps.step4.risks.map((risk) => (
                <Card key={risk.id} className="p-4">
                  <div className="flex justify-between items-start mb-2">
                    <div>
                      <div className="font-semibold mb-1">{risk.type}</div>
                      <div className="flex gap-2">
                        <Badge variant="secondary">
                          Severidad:{" "}
                          {t(
                            `compliance.fria.steps.step4.severityOptions.${risk.severity}`
                          )}
                        </Badge>
                        <Badge variant="secondary">
                          Probabilidad: {(risk.probability * 100).toFixed(0)}%
                        </Badge>
                        <Badge variant="secondary">
                          Impacto:{" "}
                          {t(
                            `compliance.fria.steps.step4.impactOptions.${risk.impact}`
                          )}
                        </Badge>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  <p className="text-sm mt-2">{risk.description}</p>
                </Card>
              ))}
            </div>
          </CardBody>
        </Card>

        {/* Step 5: Human Oversight */}
        <Card>
          <CardHeader>
            <CardTitle>
              Paso 5: {t("compliance.fria.steps.step5.title")} (Art. 27.1.e)
            </CardTitle>
          </CardHeader>
          <CardBody>
            <div className="space-y-4">
              <div>
                <div className="text-sm text-muted-foreground mb-2">
                  HITL Habilitado
                </div>
                <Badge variant={fria.steps.step5.hitlEnabled ? "default" : "secondary"}>
                  {fria.steps.step5.hitlEnabled ? "Sí" : "No"}
                </Badge>
              </div>
              <div>
                <div className="text-sm text-muted-foreground mb-2">
                  Descripción
                </div>
                <p className="whitespace-pre-wrap">{fria.steps.step5.humanOversight}</p>
              </div>
            </div>
          </CardBody>
        </Card>

        {/* Step 6: Mitigation Measures */}
        <Card>
          <CardHeader>
            <CardTitle>
              Paso 6: {t("compliance.fria.steps.step6.title")} (Art. 27.1.f)
            </CardTitle>
          </CardHeader>
          <CardBody>
            <div className="space-y-4">
              {fria.steps.step6.mitigationMeasures.map((measure) => {
                const associatedRisk = fria.steps.step4.risks.find(
                  (r) => r.id === measure.associatedRiskId
                );
                return (
                  <Card key={measure.id} className="p-4">
                    <div className="flex justify-between items-start mb-2">
                      <div className="flex-1">
                        <p className="mb-2">{measure.description}</p>
                        <div className="flex gap-2">
                          <Badge variant="secondary">
                            Efectividad: {(measure.effectiveness * 100).toFixed(0)}%
                          </Badge>
                          {associatedRisk && (
                            <Badge variant="outline">
                              Riesgo: {associatedRisk.type}
                            </Badge>
                          )}
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </Card>
                );
              })}
            </div>
          </CardBody>
        </Card>

        {/* Additional Information */}
        <Card>
          <CardHeader>
            <CardTitle>Información Adicional</CardTitle>
          </CardHeader>
          <CardBody>
            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4">
              <div>
                <div className="text-sm text-muted-foreground mb-1">
                  Notificación a Autoridades
                </div>
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                  {fria.authorityNotified ? (
                    <>
                      <CheckCircle className="h-4 w-4 text-green-500" />
                      <span>
                        Notificado el{" "}
                        {fria.authorityNotifiedAt &&
                          new Date(
                            fria.authorityNotifiedAt
                          ).toLocaleDateString()}
                      </span>
                    </>
                  ) : (
                    <>
                      <AlertTriangle className="h-4 w-4 text-yellow-500" />
                      <span>No notificado</span>
                    </>
                  )}
                </div>
              </div>
              <div>
                <div className="text-sm text-muted-foreground mb-1">
                  DPIA Vinculado
                </div>
                {fria.dpiaId ? (
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                    <LinkIcon className="h-4 w-4" />
                    <span>{fria.dpiaId}</span>
                  </div>
                ) : (
                  <span className="text-muted-foreground">No vinculado</span>
                )}
              </div>
            </div>
          </CardBody>
        </Card>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

          </CardHeader>
          <CardBody>
            <p className="whitespace-pre-wrap">{fria.steps.step1.processDescription}</p>

        </Card>

        {/* Step 2: Usage Period & Frequency */}
        <Card>

            </CardTitle>

              <div>
                <div className="text-sm text-muted-foreground mb-1">

                  {fria.steps.step2.usagePeriodEnd}

              </div>
              <div>
                <div className="text-sm text-muted-foreground mb-1">
                  Frecuencia
                </div>
                <div>
                  {t(
                    `compliance.fria.steps.step2.frequencyOptions.${fria.steps.step2.usageFrequency}`
                  )}
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          </CardBody>
        </Card>

        {/* Step 3: Affected Categories */}
        <Card>
          <CardHeader>
            <CardTitle>
              Paso 3: {t("compliance.fria.steps.step3.title")} (Art. 27.1.c)
            </CardTitle>
          </CardHeader>
          <CardBody>
            <div className="space-y-4">
              <div>
                <div className="text-sm text-muted-foreground mb-2">
                  Categorías Afectadas
                </div>
                <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
                  {fria.steps.step3.affectedCategories.map((category, index) => (
                    <Badge key={index} variant="secondary">
                      {category}
                    </Badge>
                  ))}
                </div>
              </div>
              <div>
                <div className="text-sm text-muted-foreground mb-2">
                  Incluye Grupos Vulnerables
                </div>
                <Badge variant={fria.steps.step3.vulnerableGroupsIncluded ? "default" : "secondary"}>
                  {fria.steps.step3.vulnerableGroupsIncluded ? "Sí" : "No"}
                </Badge>
              </div>
              {fria.steps.step3.vulnerableGroupsIncluded && fria.steps.step3.vulnerableGroups && (
                <div>
                  <div className="text-sm text-muted-foreground mb-2">
                    Grupos Vulnerables
                  </div>
                  <p>{fria.steps.step3.vulnerableGroups}</p>
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          </CardBody>
        </Card>

        {/* Step 4: Risks */}
        <Card>
          <CardHeader>
            <CardTitle>
              Paso 4: {t("compliance.fria.steps.step4.title")} (Art. 27.1.d)
            </CardTitle>
          </CardHeader>
          <CardBody>
            <div className="space-y-4">
              {fria.steps.step4.risks.map((risk) => (
                <Card key={risk.id} className="p-4">
                  <div className="flex justify-between items-start mb-2">
                    <div>
                      <div className="font-semibold mb-1">{risk.type}</div>
                      <div className="flex gap-2">
                        <Badge variant="secondary">
                          Severidad:{" "}
                          {t(
                            `compliance.fria.steps.step4.severityOptions.${risk.severity}`
                          )}
                        </Badge>
                        <Badge variant="secondary">
                          Probabilidad: {(risk.probability * 100).toFixed(0)}%
                        </Badge>
                        <Badge variant="secondary">
                          Impacto:{" "}
                          {t(
                            `compliance.fria.steps.step4.impactOptions.${risk.impact}`
                          )}
                        </Badge>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  <p className="text-sm mt-2">{risk.description}</p>
                </Card>
              ))}
            </div>
          </CardBody>
        </Card>

        {/* Step 5: Human Oversight */}
        <Card>
          <CardHeader>
            <CardTitle>
              Paso 5: {t("compliance.fria.steps.step5.title")} (Art. 27.1.e)
            </CardTitle>
          </CardHeader>
          <CardBody>
            <div className="space-y-4">
              <div>
                <div className="text-sm text-muted-foreground mb-2">
                  HITL Habilitado
                </div>
                <Badge variant={fria.steps.step5.hitlEnabled ? "default" : "secondary"}>
                  {fria.steps.step5.hitlEnabled ? "Sí" : "No"}
                </Badge>
              </div>
              <div>
                <div className="text-sm text-muted-foreground mb-2">
                  Descripción
                </div>
                <p className="whitespace-pre-wrap">{fria.steps.step5.humanOversight}</p>
              </div>
            </div>
          </CardBody>
        </Card>

        {/* Step 6: Mitigation Measures */}
        <Card>
          <CardHeader>
            <CardTitle>
              Paso 6: {t("compliance.fria.steps.step6.title")} (Art. 27.1.f)
            </CardTitle>
          </CardHeader>
          <CardBody>
            <div className="space-y-4">
              {fria.steps.step6.mitigationMeasures.map((measure) => {
                const associatedRisk = fria.steps.step4.risks.find(
                  (r) => r.id === measure.associatedRiskId
                );
                return (
                  <Card key={measure.id} className="p-4">
                    <div className="flex justify-between items-start mb-2">
                      <div className="flex-1">
                        <p className="mb-2">{measure.description}</p>
                        <div className="flex gap-2">
                          <Badge variant="secondary">
                            Efectividad: {(measure.effectiveness * 100).toFixed(0)}%
                          </Badge>
                          {associatedRisk && (
                            <Badge variant="outline">
                              Riesgo: {associatedRisk.type}
                            </Badge>
                          )}
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </Card>
                );
              })}
            </div>
          </CardBody>
        </Card>

        {/* Additional Information */}
        <Card>
          <CardHeader>
            <CardTitle>Información Adicional</CardTitle>
          </CardHeader>
          <CardBody>
            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4">
              <div>
                <div className="text-sm text-muted-foreground mb-1">
                  Notificación a Autoridades
                </div>
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                  {fria.authorityNotified ? (
                    <>
                      <CheckCircle className="h-4 w-4 text-green-500" />
                      <span>
                        Notificado el{" "}
                        {fria.authorityNotifiedAt &&
                          new Date(
                            fria.authorityNotifiedAt
                          ).toLocaleDateString()}
                      </span>
                    </>
                  ) : (
                    <>
                      <AlertTriangle className="h-4 w-4 text-yellow-500" />
                      <span>No notificado</span>
                    </>
                  )}
                </div>
              </div>
              <div>
                <div className="text-sm text-muted-foreground mb-1">
                  DPIA Vinculado
                </div>
                {fria.dpiaId ? (
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                    <LinkIcon className="h-4 w-4" />
                    <span>{fria.dpiaId}</span>
                  </div>
                ) : (
                  <span className="text-muted-foreground">No vinculado</span>
                )}
              </div>
            </div>
          </CardBody>
        </Card>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

"use client";

import { useTranslation } from "@/app/config/i18n";
import { Card, CardBody, CardHeader, CardTitle } from "@/components/ui/card";
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import {
  FileText,
  ArrowLeft,
  Edit,
  Send,
  Download,
  Link as LinkIcon,
  CheckCircle,
  AlertTriangle,
} from "lucide-react";
import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import Link from "next/link";
import { useParams } from "next/navigation";

interface FriaRisk {
  id: number;
  type: string;
  severity: "low" | "medium" | "high" | "critical";
  probability: number;
  impact: "low" | "medium" | "high";
  description: string;
}

interface MitigationMeasure {
  id: number;
  description: string;
  effectiveness: number;
  associatedRiskId: number | null;
}

interface FriaDetail {
  id: number;
  projectId: number;
  projectName: string;
  createdAt: string;
  updatedAt: string;
  status: "DRAFT" | "COMPLETED" | "NOTIFIED";
  completenessScore: number;
  finalRisk: number | null;
  riskLevel: "low" | "medium" | "high" | "critical" | null;
  authorityNotified: boolean;
  authorityNotifiedAt: string | null;
  dpiaId: string | null;
  steps: {
    step1: {
      processDescription: string;
    };
    step2: {
      usagePeriodStart: string;
      usagePeriodEnd: string;
      usageFrequency: string;
    };
    step3: {
      affectedCategories: string[];
      vulnerableGroups: string;
      vulnerableGroupsIncluded: boolean;
    };
    step4: {
      risks: FriaRisk[];
    };
    step5: {
      humanOversight: string;
      hitlEnabled: boolean;
    };
    step6: {
      mitigationMeasures: MitigationMeasure[];
    };
  };
}

const mockFriaDetail: FriaDetail = {
  id: 1,
  projectId: 1001,
  projectName: "AI Credit Scoring System",
  createdAt: "2025-12-01T10:00:00Z",
  updatedAt: "2025-12-01T15:30:00Z",
  status: "COMPLETED",
  completenessScore: 0.95,
  finalRisk: 0.42,
  riskLevel: "medium",
  authorityNotified: false,
  authorityNotifiedAt: null,
  dpiaId: null,
  steps: {
    step1: {
      processDescription:
        "The AI system is used for automated credit scoring in loan applications. It analyzes applicant data including financial history, employment status, and demographic information to determine creditworthiness.",
    },
    step2: {
      usagePeriodStart: "2024-01-01",
      usagePeriodEnd: "2025-12-31",
      usageFrequency: "daily",
    },
    step3: {
      affectedCategories: [
        "Loan applicants",
        "Credit card applicants",
        "Low-income individuals",
      ],
      vulnerableGroups: "Recent immigrants, individuals with limited credit history",
      vulnerableGroupsIncluded: true,
    },
    step4: {
      risks: [
        {
          id: 1,
          type: "Discrimination",
          severity: "high",
          probability: 0.75,
          impact: "high",
          description:
            "Risk of discrimination based on protected characteristics such as race, gender, or age",
        },
        {
          id: 2,
          type: "Privacy",
          severity: "medium",
          probability: 0.50,
          impact: "medium",
          description:
            "Risk of unauthorized access to sensitive financial data",
        },
      ],
    },
    step5: {
      humanOversight:
        "Human reviewers will review all loan rejections and decisions with scores below 0.6. Pre-deployment review required for model updates. In-loop supervision for high-value loans (>€50,000).",
      hitlEnabled: true,
    },
    step6: {
      mitigationMeasures: [
        {
          id: 1,
          description: "Regular bias audits every quarter",
          effectiveness: 0.80,
          associatedRiskId: 1,
        },
        {
          id: 2,
          description: "Encryption and access controls for data",
          effectiveness: 0.90,
          associatedRiskId: 2,
        },
      ],
    },
  },
};

export default function FriaDetailPage() {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const params = useParams();
  const friaId = params.id as string;
  const [fria, setFria] = useState<FriaDetail | null>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);

  useEffect(() => {
    loadFriaDetail();
  }, [friaId]);

  const loadFriaDetail = async () => {
    try {
      setLoading(true);
      // TODO: Reemplazar con llamada real a API
      await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 500));
      setFria(mockFriaDetail);
    } catch (error) {
      console.error("Error loading FRIA detail:", error);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const notifyAuthority = async () => {
    if (!fria) return;
    try {
      const response = await fetch(
        `/api/compliance/fria/${fria.id}/notify-authority`,
        {
          method: "POST",
        }
      );
      const result = await response.json();
      if (result.success) {
        loadFriaDetail();
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error("Error notifying authority:", error);
    }
  };

  if (loading || !fria) {
    return (
      <div className="flex items-center justify-center min-h-screen">
        <div className="animate-spin rounded-full h-12 w-12 border-b-2 border-primary"></div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-gradient-to-br from-background via-background to-background/80 relative overflow-hidden">

      <div className="relative z-10 w-full px-4 py-6 space-y-6">
        {/* Header */}
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
            <Link href="/governance/compliance/fria/assessments">
              <Button variant="ghost" size="sm">
                <ArrowLeft className="h-4 w-4 mr-2" />
                {t("compliance.fria.back")}
              </Button>
            </Link>
            <div>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-3 mb-2">
                <FileText className="w-8 h-8 text-blue-500" />
                <h1 className="text-3xl font-bold bg-gradient-to-r from-blue-500 to-blue-700 bg-clip-text text-transparent">
                  {t("compliance.fria.detail", { id: fria.id })}
                </h1>
              </div>
              <p className="text-muted-foreground">{fria.projectName}</p>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div className="flex gap-2">
            {fria.status === "DRAFT" && (
              <Link href={`/governance/compliance/fria?friaId=${fria.id}`}>
                <Button variant="outline">
                  <Edit className="h-4 w-4 mr-2" />
                  {t("compliance.fria.edit")}
                </Button>
              </Link>
            )}
            {fria.status === "COMPLETED" &&
              fria.finalRisk !== null &&
              fria.finalRisk >= 0.75 &&
              !fria.authorityNotified && (
                <Button variant="outline" onClick={notifyAuthority}>
                  <Send className="h-4 w-4 mr-2" />
                  {t("compliance.fria.notifyAuthority")}
                </Button>
              )}
            <Button variant="outline">
              <Download className="h-4 w-4 mr-2" />
              {t("compliance.fria.exportPDF")}
            </Button>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Summary Cards */}
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4 gap-4">
          <Card>
            <CardBody>
              <div className="text-sm text-muted-foreground mb-1">{t("compliance.fria.state")}</div>
              <Badge
                variant={
                  fria.status === "NOTIFIED"
                    ? "destructive"
                    : fria.status === "COMPLETED"
                    ? "default"
                    : "secondary"
                }
              >
                {t(`compliance.fria.status.${fria.status.toLowerCase()}`)}
              </Badge>
            </CardBody>
          </Card>
          <Card>
            <CardBody>
              <div className="text-sm text-muted-foreground mb-1">
                {t("compliance.fria.completeness")}
              </div>
              <div className="text-2xl font-bold">
                {(fria.completenessScore * 100).toFixed(0)}%
              </div>
            </CardBody>
          </Card>
          <Card>
            <CardBody>
              <div className="text-sm text-muted-foreground mb-1">
                Riesgo Final
              </div>
              {fria.finalRisk !== null ? (
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                  <div className="text-2xl font-bold">
                    {(fria.finalRisk * 100).toFixed(0)}%
                  </div>
                  <Badge
                    variant={
                      fria.riskLevel === "high" || fria.riskLevel === "critical"
                        ? "destructive"
                        : "default"
                    }
                  >
                    {fria.riskLevel &&
                      t(`compliance.fria.riskLevels.${fria.riskLevel}`)}
                  </Badge>
                </div>
              ) : (
                <span className="text-muted-foreground">-</span>
              )}
            </CardBody>
          </Card>
          <Card>
            <CardBody>
              <div className="text-sm text-muted-foreground mb-1">
                Fecha Creación
              </div>
              <div className="text-sm">
                {new Date(fria.createdAt).toLocaleDateString()}
              </div>
            </CardBody>
          </Card>
        </div>

        {/* Step 1: Process Description */}
        <Card>
          <CardHeader>
            <CardTitle>
              Paso 1: {t("compliance.fria.steps.step1.title")} (Art. 27.1.a)
            </CardTitle>
          </CardHeader>
          <CardBody>
            <p className="whitespace-pre-wrap">{fria.steps.step1.processDescription}</p>
          </CardBody>
        </Card>

        {/* Step 2: Usage Period & Frequency */}
        <Card>
          <CardHeader>
            <CardTitle>
              Paso 2: {t("compliance.fria.steps.step2.title")} (Art. 27.1.b)
            </CardTitle>
          </CardHeader>
          <CardBody>
            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4">
              <div>
                <div className="text-sm text-muted-foreground mb-1">
                  Período de Uso

                  {fria.steps.step2.usagePeriodStart} -{" "}
                  {fria.steps.step2.usagePeriodEnd}
                </div>

              <div>
                <div className="text-sm text-muted-foreground mb-1">

            </div>
          </CardBody>
        </Card>

        {/* Step 3: Affected Categories */}
        <Card>
          <CardHeader>
            <CardTitle>
              Paso 3: {t("compliance.fria.steps.step3.title")} (Art. 27.1.c)
            </CardTitle>
          </CardHeader>
          <CardBody>
            <div className="space-y-4">
              <div>
                <div className="text-sm text-muted-foreground mb-2">

                <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">

                    </Badge>
                  ))}

              </div>
              <div>
                <div className="text-sm text-muted-foreground mb-2">

                </div>
                <Badge variant={fria.steps.step3.vulnerableGroupsIncluded ? "default" : "secondary"}>

              {fria.steps.step3.vulnerableGroupsIncluded && fria.steps.step3.vulnerableGroups && (

        {/* Step 4: Risks */}
        <Card>

        {/* Step 5: Human Oversight */}

        <Card>

                      </div>
                    </div>

              })}
            </div>
          </CardBody>
        </Card>

        {/* Additional Information */}
        <Card>

          <CardBody>
            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4">

import { useTranslation } from "@/app/config/i18n";
import { Card, CardBody, CardHeader, CardTitle } from "@/components/ui/card";
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import {
  FileText,
  ArrowLeft,
  Edit,
  Send,
  Download,
  Link as LinkIcon,
  CheckCircle,
  AlertTriangle,
} from "lucide-react";
import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import Link from "next/link";
import { useParams } from "next/navigation";

interface FriaRisk {
  id: number;
  type: string;
  severity: "low" | "medium" | "high" | "critical";
  probability: number;
  impact: "low" | "medium" | "high";
  description: string;
}

interface MitigationMeasure {
  id: number;
  description: string;
  effectiveness: number;
  associatedRiskId: number | null;
}

interface FriaDetail {
  id: number;
  projectId: number;
  projectName: string;
  createdAt: string;
  updatedAt: string;
  status: "DRAFT" | "COMPLETED" | "NOTIFIED";
  completenessScore: number;
  finalRisk: number | null;
  riskLevel: "low" | "medium" | "high" | "critical" | null;
  authorityNotified: boolean;
  authorityNotifiedAt: string | null;
  dpiaId: string | null;
  steps: {
    step1: {
      processDescription: string;
    };
    step2: {
      usagePeriodStart: string;
      usagePeriodEnd: string;
      usageFrequency: string;
    };
    step3: {
      affectedCategories: string[];
      vulnerableGroups: string;
      vulnerableGroupsIncluded: boolean;
    };
    step4: {
      risks: FriaRisk[];
    };
    step5: {
      humanOversight: string;
      hitlEnabled: boolean;
    };
    step6: {
      mitigationMeasures: MitigationMeasure[];
    };
  };
}

const mockFriaDetail: FriaDetail = {
  id: 1,
  projectId: 1001,
  projectName: "AI Credit Scoring System",
  createdAt: "2025-12-01T10:00:00Z",
  updatedAt: "2025-12-01T15:30:00Z",
  status: "COMPLETED",
  completenessScore: 0.95,
  finalRisk: 0.42,
  riskLevel: "medium",
  authorityNotified: false,
  authorityNotifiedAt: null,
  dpiaId: null,
  steps: {
    step1: {
      processDescription:
        "The AI system is used for automated credit scoring in loan applications. It analyzes applicant data including financial history, employment status, and demographic information to determine creditworthiness.",
    },
    step2: {
      usagePeriodStart: "2024-01-01",
      usagePeriodEnd: "2025-12-31",
      usageFrequency: "daily",
    },
    step3: {
      affectedCategories: [
        "Loan applicants",
        "Credit card applicants",
        "Low-income individuals",
      ],
      vulnerableGroups: "Recent immigrants, individuals with limited credit history",
      vulnerableGroupsIncluded: true,
    },
    step4: {
      risks: [
        {
          id: 1,
          type: "Discrimination",
          severity: "high",
          probability: 0.75,
          impact: "high",
          description:
            "Risk of discrimination based on protected characteristics such as race, gender, or age",
        },
        {
          id: 2,
          type: "Privacy",
          severity: "medium",
          probability: 0.50,
          impact: "medium",
          description:
            "Risk of unauthorized access to sensitive financial data",
        },
      ],
    },
    step5: {
      humanOversight:
        "Human reviewers will review all loan rejections and decisions with scores below 0.6. Pre-deployment review required for model updates. In-loop supervision for high-value loans (>€50,000).",
      hitlEnabled: true,
    },
    step6: {
      mitigationMeasures: [
        {
          id: 1,
          description: "Regular bias audits every quarter",
          effectiveness: 0.80,
          associatedRiskId: 1,
        },
        {
          id: 2,
          description: "Encryption and access controls for data",
          effectiveness: 0.90,
          associatedRiskId: 2,
        },
      ],
    },
  },
};

export default function FriaDetailPage() {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const params = useParams();
  const friaId = params.id as string;
  const [fria, setFria] = useState<FriaDetail | null>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);

  useEffect(() => {
    loadFriaDetail();
  }, [friaId]);

  const loadFriaDetail = async () => {
    try {
      setLoading(true);
      // TODO: Reemplazar con llamada real a API
      await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 500));
      setFria(mockFriaDetail);
    } catch (error) {
      console.error("Error loading FRIA detail:", error);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const notifyAuthority = async () => {
    if (!fria) return;
    try {
      const response = await fetch(
        `/api/compliance/fria/${fria.id}/notify-authority`,
        {
          method: "POST",
        }
      );
      const result = await response.json();
      if (result.success) {
        loadFriaDetail();
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error("Error notifying authority:", error);
    }
  };

  if (loading || !fria) {
    return (
      <div className="flex items-center justify-center min-h-screen">
        <div className="animate-spin rounded-full h-12 w-12 border-b-2 border-primary"></div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-gradient-to-br from-background via-background to-background/80 relative overflow-hidden">

      <div className="relative z-10 w-full px-4 py-6 space-y-6">
        {/* Header */}
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
            <Link href="/governance/compliance/fria/assessments">
              <Button variant="ghost" size="sm">
                <ArrowLeft className="h-4 w-4 mr-2" />
                {t("compliance.fria.back")}
              </Button>
            </Link>
            <div>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-3 mb-2">
                <FileText className="w-8 h-8 text-blue-500" />
                <h1 className="text-3xl font-bold bg-gradient-to-r from-blue-500 to-blue-700 bg-clip-text text-transparent">
                  {t("compliance.fria.detail", { id: fria.id })}
                </h1>
              </div>
              <p className="text-muted-foreground">{fria.projectName}</p>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div className="flex gap-2">
            {fria.status === "DRAFT" && (
              <Link href={`/governance/compliance/fria?friaId=${fria.id}`}>
                <Button variant="outline">
                  <Edit className="h-4 w-4 mr-2" />
                  {t("compliance.fria.edit")}
                </Button>
              </Link>
            )}
            {fria.status === "COMPLETED" &&
              fria.finalRisk !== null &&
              fria.finalRisk >= 0.75 &&
              !fria.authorityNotified && (
                <Button variant="outline" onClick={notifyAuthority}>
                  <Send className="h-4 w-4 mr-2" />
                  {t("compliance.fria.notifyAuthority")}
                </Button>
              )}
            <Button variant="outline">
              <Download className="h-4 w-4 mr-2" />
              {t("compliance.fria.exportPDF")}
            </Button>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Summary Cards */}
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4 gap-4">
          <Card>
            <CardBody>
              <div className="text-sm text-muted-foreground mb-1">{t("compliance.fria.state")}</div>
              <Badge
                variant={
                  fria.status === "NOTIFIED"
                    ? "destructive"
                    : fria.status === "COMPLETED"
                    ? "default"
                    : "secondary"
                }
              >
                {t(`compliance.fria.status.${fria.status.toLowerCase()}`)}
              </Badge>
            </CardBody>
          </Card>
          <Card>
            <CardBody>
              <div className="text-sm text-muted-foreground mb-1">
                {t("compliance.fria.completeness")}
              </div>
              <div className="text-2xl font-bold">
                {(fria.completenessScore * 100).toFixed(0)}%
              </div>
            </CardBody>
          </Card>
          <Card>
            <CardBody>
              <div className="text-sm text-muted-foreground mb-1">
                {t("compliance.fria.finalRisk")}
              </div>
              {fria.finalRisk !== null ? (
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                  <div className="text-2xl font-bold">
                    {(fria.finalRisk * 100).toFixed(0)}%
                  </div>
                  <Badge
                    variant={
                      fria.riskLevel === "high" || fria.riskLevel === "critical"
                        ? "destructive"
                        : "default"
                    }
                  >
                    {fria.riskLevel &&
                      t(`compliance.fria.riskLevels.${fria.riskLevel}`)}
                  </Badge>
                </div>
              ) : (
                <span className="text-muted-foreground">-</span>
              )}
            </CardBody>
          </Card>
          <Card>
            <CardBody>
              <div className="text-sm text-muted-foreground mb-1">
                Fecha Creación
              </div>
              <div className="text-sm">
                {new Date(fria.createdAt).toLocaleDateString()}
              </div>
            </CardBody>
          </Card>
        </div>

        {/* Step 1: Process Description */}
        <Card>
          <CardHeader>
            <CardTitle>
              Paso 1: {t("compliance.fria.steps.step1.title")} (Art. 27.1.a)
            </CardTitle>
          </CardHeader>
          <CardBody>
            <p className="whitespace-pre-wrap">{fria.steps.step1.processDescription}</p>
          </CardBody>
        </Card>

        {/* Step 2: Usage Period & Frequency */}
        <Card>
          <CardHeader>
            <CardTitle>
              Paso 2: {t("compliance.fria.steps.step2.title")} (Art. 27.1.b)
            </CardTitle>
          </CardHeader>
          <CardBody>
            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4">
              <div>
                <div className="text-sm text-muted-foreground mb-1">
                  Período de Uso
                </div>
                <div>
                  {fria.steps.step2.usagePeriodStart} -{" "}
                  {fria.steps.step2.usagePeriodEnd}
                </div>
              </div>
              <div>
                <div className="text-sm text-muted-foreground mb-1">
                  Frecuencia
                </div>
                <div>
                  {t(
                    `compliance.fria.steps.step2.frequencyOptions.${fria.steps.step2.usageFrequency}`
                  )}
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          </CardBody>
        </Card>

        {/* Step 3: Affected Categories */}
        <Card>
          <CardHeader>
            <CardTitle>
              Paso 3: {t("compliance.fria.steps.step3.title")} (Art. 27.1.c)
            </CardTitle>
          </CardHeader>
          <CardBody>
            <div className="space-y-4">
              <div>
                <div className="text-sm text-muted-foreground mb-2">
                  Categorías Afectadas
                </div>
                <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
                  {fria.steps.step3.affectedCategories.map((category, index) => (
                    <Badge key={index} variant="secondary">
                      {category}
                    </Badge>
                  ))}
                </div>
              </div>
              <div>
                <div className="text-sm text-muted-foreground mb-2">
                  Incluye Grupos Vulnerables
                </div>
                <Badge variant={fria.steps.step3.vulnerableGroupsIncluded ? "default" : "secondary"}>
                  {fria.steps.step3.vulnerableGroupsIncluded ? "Sí" : "No"}
                </Badge>
              </div>
              {fria.steps.step3.vulnerableGroupsIncluded && fria.steps.step3.vulnerableGroups && (
                <div>
                  <div className="text-sm text-muted-foreground mb-2">
                    Grupos Vulnerables
                  </div>
                  <p>{fria.steps.step3.vulnerableGroups}</p>
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          </CardBody>
        </Card>

        {/* Step 4: Risks */}
        <Card>
          <CardHeader>
            <CardTitle>
              Paso 4: {t("compliance.fria.steps.step4.title")} (Art. 27.1.d)
            </CardTitle>
          </CardHeader>
          <CardBody>
            <div className="space-y-4">
              {fria.steps.step4.risks.map((risk) => (
                <Card key={risk.id} className="p-4">
                  <div className="flex justify-between items-start mb-2">
                    <div>
                      <div className="font-semibold mb-1">{risk.type}</div>
                      <div className="flex gap-2">
                        <Badge variant="secondary">
                          Severidad:{" "}
                          {t(
                            `compliance.fria.steps.step4.severityOptions.${risk.severity}`
                          )}
                        </Badge>
                        <Badge variant="secondary">
                          Probabilidad: {(risk.probability * 100).toFixed(0)}%
                        </Badge>
                        <Badge variant="secondary">
                          Impacto:{" "}
                          {t(
                            `compliance.fria.steps.step4.impactOptions.${risk.impact}`
                          )}
                        </Badge>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  <p className="text-sm mt-2">{risk.description}</p>
                </Card>
              ))}
            </div>
          </CardBody>
        </Card>

        {/* Step 5: Human Oversight */}
        <Card>
          <CardHeader>
            <CardTitle>
              Paso 5: {t("compliance.fria.steps.step5.title")} (Art. 27.1.e)
            </CardTitle>
          </CardHeader>
          <CardBody>
            <div className="space-y-4">
              <div>
                <div className="text-sm text-muted-foreground mb-2">
                  HITL Habilitado
                </div>
                <Badge variant={fria.steps.step5.hitlEnabled ? "default" : "secondary"}>
                  {fria.steps.step5.hitlEnabled ? "Sí" : "No"}
                </Badge>
              </div>
              <div>
                <div className="text-sm text-muted-foreground mb-2">
                  Descripción
                </div>
                <p className="whitespace-pre-wrap">{fria.steps.step5.humanOversight}</p>
              </div>
            </div>
          </CardBody>
        </Card>

        {/* Step 6: Mitigation Measures */}
        <Card>
          <CardHeader>
            <CardTitle>
              Paso 6: {t("compliance.fria.steps.step6.title")} (Art. 27.1.f)
            </CardTitle>
          </CardHeader>
          <CardBody>
            <div className="space-y-4">
              {fria.steps.step6.mitigationMeasures.map((measure) => {
                const associatedRisk = fria.steps.step4.risks.find(
                  (r) => r.id === measure.associatedRiskId
                );
                return (
                  <Card key={measure.id} className="p-4">
                    <div className="flex justify-between items-start mb-2">
                      <div className="flex-1">
                        <p className="mb-2">{measure.description}</p>
                        <div className="flex gap-2">
                          <Badge variant="secondary">
                            Efectividad: {(measure.effectiveness * 100).toFixed(0)}%
                          </Badge>
                          {associatedRisk && (
                            <Badge variant="outline">
                              Riesgo: {associatedRisk.type}
                            </Badge>
                          )}
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </Card>
                );
              })}
            </div>
          </CardBody>
        </Card>

        {/* Additional Information */}
        <Card>
          <CardHeader>
            <CardTitle>Información Adicional</CardTitle>
          </CardHeader>
          <CardBody>
            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4">
              <div>
                <div className="text-sm text-muted-foreground mb-1">
                  Notificación a Autoridades
                </div>
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                  {fria.authorityNotified ? (
                    <>
                      <CheckCircle className="h-4 w-4 text-green-500" />
                      <span>
                        Notificado el{" "}
                        {fria.authorityNotifiedAt &&
                          new Date(
                            fria.authorityNotifiedAt
                          ).toLocaleDateString()}
                      </span>
                    </>
                  ) : (
                    <>
                      <AlertTriangle className="h-4 w-4 text-yellow-500" />
                      <span>No notificado</span>
                    </>
                  )}
                </div>
              </div>
              <div>
                <div className="text-sm text-muted-foreground mb-1">
                  DPIA Vinculado
                </div>
                {fria.dpiaId ? (
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                    <LinkIcon className="h-4 w-4" />
                    <span>{fria.dpiaId}</span>
                  </div>
                ) : (
                  <span className="text-muted-foreground">No vinculado</span>
                )}
              </div>
            </div>
          </CardBody>
        </Card>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

              <Link href={`/governance/compliance/fria?friaId=${fria.id}`}>

        {/* Step 1: Process Description */}
        <Card>

        {/* Step 3: Affected Categories */}

                </div>

                  {fria.steps.step3.vulnerableGroupsIncluded ? "Sí" : "No"}
                </Badge>
              </div>
              {fria.steps.step3.vulnerableGroupsIncluded && fria.steps.step3.vulnerableGroups && (

        {/* Step 4: Risks */}

          <CardHeader>

                        <Badge variant="secondary">

        <Card>

          <CardBody>
            <div className="space-y-4">
              <div>
                <div className="text-sm text-muted-foreground mb-2">
                  HITL Habilitado
                </div>
                <Badge variant={fria.steps.step5.hitlEnabled ? "default" : "secondary"}>
                  {fria.steps.step5.hitlEnabled ? "Sí" : "No"}
                </Badge>
              </div>
              <div>
                <div className="text-sm text-muted-foreground mb-2">
                  Descripción
                </div>
                <p className="whitespace-pre-wrap">{fria.steps.step5.humanOversight}</p>
              </div>
            </div>
          </CardBody>
        </Card>

        {/* Step 6: Mitigation Measures */}
        <Card>
          <CardHeader>
            <CardTitle>
              Paso 6: {t("compliance.fria.steps.step6.title")} (Art. 27.1.f)
            </CardTitle>
          </CardHeader>
          <CardBody>
            <div className="space-y-4">
              {fria.steps.step6.mitigationMeasures.map((measure) => {
                const associatedRisk = fria.steps.step4.risks.find(
                  (r) => r.id === measure.associatedRiskId
                );
                return (
                  <Card key={measure.id} className="p-4">
                    <div className="flex justify-between items-start mb-2">
                      <div className="flex-1">
                        <p className="mb-2">{measure.description}</p>
                        <div className="flex gap-2">

                            Efectividad: {(measure.effectiveness * 100).toFixed(0)}%
                          </Badge>
                          {associatedRisk && (
                            <Badge variant="outline">
                              Riesgo: {associatedRisk.type}
                            </Badge>
                          )}
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </Card>
                );
              })}
            </div>
          </CardBody>
        </Card>

        {/* Additional Information */}
        <Card>
          <CardHeader>
            <CardTitle>Información Adicional</CardTitle>
          </CardHeader>
          <CardBody>
            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4">
              <div>

                  Notificación a Autoridades
                </div>
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                  {fria.authorityNotified ? (
                    <>
                      <CheckCircle className="h-4 w-4 text-green-500" />
                      <span>
                        Notificado el{" "}
                        {fria.authorityNotifiedAt &&
                          new Date(
                            fria.authorityNotifiedAt
                          ).toLocaleDateString()}
                      </span>
                    </>
                  ) : (
                    <>
                      <AlertTriangle className="h-4 w-4 text-yellow-500" />
                      <span>No notificado</span>
                    </>
                  )}
                </div>
              </div>
              <div>
                <div className="text-sm text-muted-foreground mb-1">
                  DPIA Vinculado
                </div>
                {fria.dpiaId ? (
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                    <LinkIcon className="h-4 w-4" />
                    <span>{fria.dpiaId}</span>
                  </div>
                ) : (
                  <span className="text-muted-foreground">No vinculado</span>
                )}
              </div>
            </div>
          </CardBody>
        </Card>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

"use client";

import { useTranslation } from "@/app/config/i18n";
import { Card, CardBody, CardHeader, CardTitle } from "@/components/ui/card";
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import {
  FileText,
  ArrowLeft,
  Edit,
  Send,
  Download,
  Link as LinkIcon,
  CheckCircle,
  AlertTriangle,
} from "lucide-react";
import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import Link from "next/link";
import { useParams } from "next/navigation";

interface FriaRisk {
  id: number;
  type: string;
  severity: "low" | "medium" | "high" | "critical";
  probability: number;
  impact: "low" | "medium" | "high";
  description: string;
}

interface MitigationMeasure {
  id: number;
  description: string;
  effectiveness: number;
  associatedRiskId: number | null;
}

interface FriaDetail {
  id: number;
  projectId: number;
  projectName: string;
  createdAt: string;
  updatedAt: string;
  status: "DRAFT" | "COMPLETED" | "NOTIFIED";
  completenessScore: number;
  finalRisk: number | null;
  riskLevel: "low" | "medium" | "high" | "critical" | null;
  authorityNotified: boolean;
  authorityNotifiedAt: string | null;
  dpiaId: string | null;
  steps: {
    step1: {
      processDescription: string;
    };
    step2: {
      usagePeriodStart: string;
      usagePeriodEnd: string;
      usageFrequency: string;
    };
    step3: {
      affectedCategories: string[];
      vulnerableGroups: string;
      vulnerableGroupsIncluded: boolean;
    };
    step4: {
      risks: FriaRisk[];
    };
    step5: {
      humanOversight: string;
      hitlEnabled: boolean;
    };
    step6: {
      mitigationMeasures: MitigationMeasure[];
    };
  };
}

const mockFriaDetail: FriaDetail = {
  id: 1,

      hitlEnabled: true,

export default function FriaDetailPage() {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const params = useParams();
  const friaId = params.id as string;
  const [fria, setFria] = useState<FriaDetail | null>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);

  useEffect(() => {
    loadFriaDetail();
  }, [friaId]);

  const loadFriaDetail = async () => {
    try {
      setLoading(true);
      // TODO: Reemplazar con llamada real a API
      await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 500));
      setFria(mockFriaDetail);

    }

        {

        }

        loadFriaDetail();
      }

      console.error("Error notifying authority:", error);
    }
  };

                          </Badge>

                            <Badge variant="outline">
                              Riesgo: {associatedRisk.type}
                            </Badge>
                          )}
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </Card>
                );
              })}
            </div>
          </CardBody>
        </Card>

        {/* Additional Information */}
        <Card>
          <CardHeader>
            <CardTitle>Información Adicional</CardTitle>
          </CardHeader>
          <CardBody>
            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4">
              <div>
                <div className="text-sm text-muted-foreground mb-1">
                  Notificación a Autoridades
                </div>
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                  {fria.authorityNotified ? (
                    <>
                      <CheckCircle className="h-4 w-4 text-green-500" />
                      <span>
                        Notificado el{" "}
                        {fria.authorityNotifiedAt &&
                          new Date(
                            fria.authorityNotifiedAt
                          ).toLocaleDateString()}
                      </span>
                    </>
                  ) : (
                    <>
                      <AlertTriangle className="h-4 w-4 text-yellow-500" />
                      <span>No notificado</span>
                    </>
                  )}
                </div>
              </div>
              <div>
                <div className="text-sm text-muted-foreground mb-1">
                  DPIA Vinculado
                </div>
                {fria.dpiaId ? (
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                    <LinkIcon className="h-4 w-4" />
                    <span>{fria.dpiaId}</span>
                  </div>
                ) : (
                  <span className="text-muted-foreground">No vinculado</span>
                )}
              </div>
            </div>
          </CardBody>
        </Card>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

"use client";

import { useTranslation } from "@/app/config/i18n";
import { Card, CardBody, CardHeader, CardTitle } from "@/components/ui/card";

import Link from "next/link";

interface FriaRisk {
  id: number;

  severity: "low" | "medium" | "high" | "critical";

  description: string;
}

interface MitigationMeasure {
  id: number;
  description: string;
  effectiveness: number;
  associatedRiskId: number | null;
}

interface FriaDetail {
  id: number;
  projectId: number;
  projectName: string;
  createdAt: string;
  updatedAt: string;
  status: "DRAFT" | "COMPLETED" | "NOTIFIED";
  completenessScore: number;
  finalRisk: number | null;
  riskLevel: "low" | "medium" | "high" | "critical" | null;
  authorityNotified: boolean;
  authorityNotifiedAt: string | null;
  dpiaId: string | null;
  steps: {
    step1: {
      processDescription: string;
    };
    step2: {
      usagePeriodStart: string;
      usagePeriodEnd: string;
      usageFrequency: string;
    };
    step3: {
      affectedCategories: string[];
      vulnerableGroups: string;
      vulnerableGroupsIncluded: boolean;
    };
    step4: {
      risks: FriaRisk[];
    };
    step5: {
      humanOversight: string;
      hitlEnabled: boolean;
    };
